title: Swinging without seeing
explanation: A stick swung in darkness may miss its intended target because the person cannot see where to aim. The expression describes guesses or effort without adequate information. Its criticism is not that no effort is being made, but that effort has no dependable direction.
meaning_odia: ଅନ୍ଧାରରେ ବାଡ଼ି ବୁଲାଇଲେ ଲକ୍ଷ୍ୟ କେଉଁଠି ଅଛି ଜଣା ନଥାଏ। ଆବଶ୍ୟକ ତଥ୍ୟ ନଜାଣି ଅନୁମାନରେ କାମ କରିବା ବା ଉତ୍ତର ଦେବାକୁ ଏହି ରୂଢ଼ି ବୁଝାଏ। ଚେଷ୍ଟା ହେଉଛି, କିନ୍ତୁ ଦିଗ ସ୍ପଷ୍ଟ ନାହିଁ—ଏହି ତଫାତଟି ମନେ ରଖିବା ଦରକାର।
usage_example: Several people keep changing settings on a faulty device without checking what has failed. One suggests identifying the problem first instead of trying changes at random. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: This is an idiomatic action phrase rather than a complete rhyming couplet. Darkness is the image for missing information; no specific origin incident has been established.

title: Darkness beneath the lamp
explanation: The source applies the image to someone who attends to others while neglecting those close by. Light reaching outward does not mean every nearby place receives it.
meaning_odia: ଦୀପର ଆଲୁଅ ବାହାରକୁ ଯାଉଛି, ହେଲେ ତାହାର ପାଖରେ ଅନ୍ଧାର ରହିଯାଇଛି। ଉତ୍ସର ବ୍ୟାଖ୍ୟାରେ ଏହା ଅନ୍ୟଙ୍କ ପ୍ରତି ଧ୍ୟାନ ଦେଇ ନିଜ ପାଖର ଲୋକଙ୍କୁ ଅବହେଳା କରିବାର ଚିତ୍ର। ଦୂରର ଆବଶ୍ୟକତା ଦେଖିବା ସହ ନିକଟର ଅଭାବ ଆଖିରୁ ଖସିଯାଉଛି କି ନାହିଁ, ସେ କଥା ବି ଭାବିବାକୁ ହୁଏ।

title: Passing it on after dark
literal_meaning: A worthless cowrie, a bitter palm fruit—give these at night.
explanation: Two disappointing things are paired with a convenient hour for giving: darkness. The dictionary identifies the cowrie as tiny or broken and, in the latter sense, worthless shell money. The saying itself gives no explanatory story. One possible reading is a dry joke about passing on something poor when its defects may be harder to notice. The surface instruction need not become our advice: quoted critically, it can expose the attempt to make a bad offering pass for a good one. We do not infer who receives them, or a custom that required such giving.
meaning_odia: କାଣି କଉଡ଼ି ଓ ପିତା ତାଳ—ଦୁଇଟି ଅପସନ୍ଦ ହେବା ଭଳି ଜିନିଷ ସାଙ୍ଗରେ ଦେବାର ସମୟ ରଖାଯାଇଛି ରାତି। ଅଭିଧାନ କଉଡ଼ିଟିକୁ ଛୋଟ ବା ଭଙ୍ଗା, ଆଉ ଭଙ୍ଗା ଅର୍ଥରେ ମୂଲ୍ୟହୀନ ବୋଲି କହିଛି। ଅନ୍ଧାରରେ ଦୋଷ ଭଲକରି ଦେଖାନଯିବାର ସୁଯୋଗ ନେଇ ଖରାପ ଜିନିଷ ଚଳାଇଦେବାର ଶୁଖିଲା ଥଟ୍ଟା ଭାବେ ଏହାକୁ ପଢ଼ିହୁଏ। ଏହା ଆମର ପ୍ରୟୋଗମୂଳକ ପାଠ; ଉତ୍ସ ଅଲଗା ଘଟଣା ବା ବ୍ୟାଖ୍ୟା ଦେଇନାହିଁ। କାହାର ଏମିତି ଚାଲାକିକୁ ଧରି କଥାଟି କୁହାଯାଇପାରେ, ସେହି ଚାଲାକି କରିବାକୁ ପରାମର୍ଶ ଦେବା ପାଇଁ ନୁହେଁ।
english_summary: One possible reading is a dry joke about passing on something poor under cover of darkness.
odia_summary: ଖରାପ ଜିନିଷକୁ ଅନ୍ଧାରରେ ଚଳାଇଦେବାର ଚାଲାକି ଉପରେ ଏକ ସମ୍ଭାବ୍ୟ କଟାକ୍ଷ।
usage_example: Original imagined example: A friend notices that a damaged second-hand lamp is being shown to a buyer only in a dim corner. They quote the saying and ask that the lamp be brought into the light before anyone decides. This modern scene is an editorial use, not a documented trading custom.
cultural_context: The cowrie is a historical money image in the source gloss. The darkness/deception interpretation is not separately defined there and remains an editorial reading. No specific recipient, ritual, trade practice or origin is supplied. The fruit wording is retained without a botanical or dietary claim.

title: Giving, and closing the door
literal_meaning: Give to the giver; close the door to the non-giver.
explanation: The repeated sound of “ଦିଆ” changes its force at the door: giving becomes shutting someone out. Read as a compact rule of reciprocity, the line divides people according to whether they give. It can expose the calculating side of an exchange in which welcome depends on a return. Our reading leaves room for a speaker to endorse that bargain or mock it; the short dictionary quotation supplies no performance setting. It should not be turned into a rule that someone unable to contribute deserves exclusion.
meaning_odia: ପ୍ରଥମେ “ଦିଆ”ରେ ଦେବାର କଥା, ଶେଷରେ “ଦୁଆର ଦିଆ”ରେ ବାଟ ବନ୍ଦ କରିବାର କଥା ଆସୁଛି। ଯିଏ ଦିଏ ତାକୁ ଦିଅ, ଯିଏ ଦିଏନାହିଁ ତାହା ପାଇଁ ଦୁଆର ବନ୍ଦ—ଏହି ହିସାବଟି କଥାରେ ଧରାପଡ଼େ। ଆଦର ଓ ସାହାଯ୍ୟ ଯେତେବେଳେ କେବଳ ପ୍ରତିଦାନ ଉପରେ ନିର୍ଭର କରେ, ଆମ ପଢ଼ାରେ ତାହାର ସଂକୀର୍ଣ୍ଣତା ମଧ୍ୟ ଦିଶେ। ଏହାକୁ ସମର୍ଥନ କରି କୁହାଗଲା କି କଟାକ୍ଷରେ, ଅଭିଧାନର ଛୋଟ ଉଦାହରଣ ସେ ପ୍ରସଙ୍ଗ ଦିଏନାହିଁ।
english_summary: The sound-play turns reciprocity into a door that opens or closes according to what someone gives.
odia_summary: ଦେବାର ହିସାବରେ ଦୁଆର ଖୋଲିବା ବା ବନ୍ଦ ହେବାର ଶବ୍ଦଖେଳ।
usage_example: Original imagined example: A committee suggests helping only members who donated last year. Another member quotes the saying critically, then asks what happens to neighbours who had nothing to give.
cultural_context: ଦୁଆର ଦିଆ is explicitly glossed shutting the door against a person. Reciprocity and the critical example are editorial close reading, not a supplied moral gloss or universal custom.

title: A fitting pair
literal_meaning: Whatever suits each: soak black gram and rice.
explanation: The entry defines the opening as what is appropriate to a person or thing. Its answer brings black gram and rice together in the action of soaking. Our reading follows the pairing: usefulness can depend on what accompanies something. The quotation names no finished dish, proportion or rule for sorting people into groups.
meaning_odia: ଆରମ୍ଭର କଥାକୁ ଅଭିଧାନ ବ୍ୟକ୍ତି ବା ବସ୍ତୁ ପ୍ରତି ଯାହା ଉପଯୁକ୍ତ ବୋଲି ବୁଝାଏ। ଉତ୍ତରରେ ବିରି ଓ ଚାଉଳ ତିନ୍ତେଇବାର କାମ ଆସେ। ଆମ ପଢ଼ାରେ ମେଳଟି ମୁଖ୍ୟ—ଗୋଟିଏ ଜିନିଷ ସହ କଣ ରହୁଛି, ତାହା ତାର ଉପଯୋଗକୁ ବଦଳାଇପାରେ। ଢଗଟି କୌଣସି ପ୍ରସ୍ତୁତ ଖାଦ୍ୟର ନାମ, ପରିମାଣ ବା ମଣିଷକୁ ଗୋଷ୍ଠୀରେ ବାଣ୍ଟିବାର ନିୟମ ଦିଏନାହିଁ।
english_summary: A food pairing carries our reading about useful accompaniment.
odia_summary: ଖାଦ୍ୟର ମେଳରେ ଉପଯୋଗୀ ସଙ୍ଗତିକୁ ନେଇ ଆମ ପଢ଼ା।
usage_example: Original imagined example: ଏକ ଶିଶୁପାଠରେ ମାନଚିତ୍ରଟି ଏକା ଦେଖି ପିଲାମାନେ ବୁଝିପାରୁନଥିଲେ। ଶିକ୍ଷକ ଛୋଟ ବର୍ଣ୍ଣନାଟି ପାଖରେ ରଖି କହିଲେ, “ଏବେ ଦୁଇଟିକୁ ମିଶାଇ ପଢ଼ିବା,” ଓ ଢଗଟି ମନେ ପକାଇଲେ। / Children find a map unclear on its own. A teacher places a short description beside it: “Now read the two together,” recalling the saying. This classroom use is invented.
cultural_context: The food image and explicit appropriateness gloss are retained. Complementary teaching materials are our application, not a documented traditional use or a recipe.
